steps.name: Recover the verified Windows Python asset
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/intellij-python-3.13.5.zip"
gh api -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' repos/actions/python-versions/releases/assets/263151870 | head -c 28549021 > "$archive"
unset GH_TOKEN
test "$(wc -c < "$archive")" -eq 28549020
printf '%s  %s\n' 83953e399a4ed65460d7fa99fa53d2a91a0da742ffb744ebb2fb999c7b880e91 "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
